All terms remain subject to client approval and execution of definitive documents.

edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The aggregate purchase price for the Shares shall be USD [to be agreed in the executed definitive agreement] (the “Purchase Price”). Buyer's indicative negotiating proposal is USD 5,000,000, subject to client approval, satisfactory diligence and agreement on all definitive terms; it is not a binding offer or commitment. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the agreed Purchase Price by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by the Seller, against delivery of duly executed instruments transferring the Shares.

2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur on a date agreed in writing by the parties, no later than thirty days after signing, subject to satisfaction or written waiver by the party entitled to their benefit of the applicable closing conditions. Each party's obligation to close shall be conditioned on receipt of the approvals and third-party consents expressly identified in an agreed schedule and the absence of any applicable legal restraint prohibiting Closing. Buyer's obligation shall also be conditioned on the Seller's express warranties being accurate at Closing, subject to the materiality standards and any specified-date qualifications expressly agreed in the definitive agreement; the Seller's material performance of its pre-closing obligations; and delivery of executed share transfer instruments, share certificates if applicable, and other expressly agreed closing deliverables. Seller's obligation shall be conditioned on Buyer's material performance of its pre-closing obligations and concurrent payment of the Purchase Price. Payment and delivery shall occur concurrently. Either party may terminate by written notice if Closing has not occurred by the agreed deadline, except where that party's breach caused the failure to close; termination shall not prejudice rights arising from an antecedent breach. Conditions, consents and deliverables must be finalized before execution.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that the financial statements specifically identified by date and reporting period in Schedule 3 have been prepared in accordance with the accounting framework expressly identified in that schedule, consistently applied, and fairly present in all material respects the financial position and results for the periods covered, subject to the qualifications and specific disclosures expressly set out in Schedule 3. The identified statements, accounting framework, treatment of any interim statements and disclosure exceptions must be agreed before execution.

4. INDEMNITY. Subject to the limitations and exceptions expressly agreed in the definitive agreement, the Seller shall indemnify the Buyer for actual losses resulting from breaches of the Seller's express warranties in this Agreement. Those warranties shall survive Closing for twelve months. Claims must be notified in writing within that period, identifying the alleged breach and reasonably available particulars; timely notified claims shall survive until resolved. Recovery shall be available only to the extent aggregate covered losses exceed a deductible basket equal to 1% of the Purchase Price, and the Seller's aggregate liability shall not exceed 10% of the Purchase Price. The Buyer shall take reasonable steps to mitigate recoverable losses and shall not recover more than once for the same loss; amounts actually recovered from insurance or third parties for that loss shall be credited net of reasonable recovery costs. Specific scheduled disclosures shall qualify only the warranties to which they are expressly applied or clearly relevant. The treatment of fraud, title and authority warranties, and any other exceptions to these limitations remains reserved for express agreement before execution. Third-party claim defense and settlement procedures must also be agreed before execution.
Indicative proposal only; obtain client approval before communicating it as an authorized offer. Remove negotiating language and insert the agreed price only when definitive terms are approved.

We will provide the requested particulars and schedules once verified; all required consents, warranty standards and deliverables must be settled before signing, and this counterproposal is nonbinding.
